name: AR_CONS_BILLING_TERMS_B
description: This table contains the billing terms used to consolidate lines from various source systems into an Invoice. It includes the consolidated billing method and its associated information.

columns.name: CONS_BILLING_TERM_ID
columns.description: Consolidated billing terms identifier.

columns.name: ENABLED_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates whether the consolidated billing terms are active.

columns.name: CONS_BILLING_METHOD_CODE
columns.description: Determines the billing method used for consolidation. Valid values are:Time-based or Fulfilment-based.

columns.name: CONS_BILLING_CYCLE_ID
columns.description: Billing cycle identifier used for consolidation.
